cases.composition_edge: protocol completion of handoff wrapper → responsibility receipt → original effect/budget state
cases.construction: An old action remains unknown and can still consume within its outstanding bound. A distinct wrapper task is to deliver/accept a custody packet.

trace.observation: Recipient accepts custody for explicit obligation o/action a/generation g; effect remains unknown.
Provider marks the handoff wrapper A2A task COMPLETED.

trace.unsafe_adapter: Collapses wrapper task ID/scope with original action; invokes model-like terminal resolution and releases the old budget claim.

cases.unsafe_conclusion: The original external action can no longer consume or write.
cases.reason: HandoffReceived/custody and wrapper-task success do not supply R12's assumed authoritative terminal fact. R12 unknown permits future consumption; terminal excludes it by assumption, not by ACK.
cases.safe_relation: Update obligation owner/acceptanceKind only; retain original effect identity, unknown state and budget claim until appropriately scoped target evidence and settlement rules apply.

cases.composition_edge: handoff watermark/old assessment → new host current policy → operation Grant
cases.construction: History h1 has a cut at sequence 10 under policy pi1; a read/Observe Grant belongs to a named principal and expires at T. No Settle Grant exists. The consumer profile requires current operation-specific authorization.

trace.observation: Assessment and handoff receipt bind h1/incarnation1/10, old policy, obligation/action generation and Observe scope.
The source appends counterevidence or revocation after the cut. A new host has local history h2/incarnation2/10 and explicit ClockObserved(T+1).
trace.scope: The same integer does not identify the same prefix. Tail completeness is not established.

trace.unsafe_adapter: Compares watermark integers only, treats previous coverage as complete, reuses old Observe receipt as authorization for recipient's Settle operation.

cases.unsafe_conclusion: Old assessment is current and the new Settle operation is authorized.
cases.reason: History namespace, tail coverage, policy/time inputs, authenticated actor and operation scope were dropped. A historically true observation is not a current operation grant.
cases.safe_relation: Keep namespaced cuts and explicit coverage/loss; re-evaluate relevant policy/time/subject inputs and check the exact operation Grant. Unknown tail stays unknown; it is not manufactured counterevidence.
cases.counterexample_target: Unsafe composition under an explicitly strong current-authorization profile. R12 does not model Commit/Settle actor/Grant, so this is not claimed as a violation found in its original state graph.
